about: The Mini-games screen as a save with every entry opened has it, reached as mini-games-menu reaches it: down through all five, with each one's picture, name and caption, up to the first, down to the third, and A on it, through its fade to white. Both are given what the save holds: the Dreamport by its address, the original in onlyInOriginal.

onlyInOriginal.about: A name already saved, as in mini-games-menu, and every entry of the Mini-games screen opened, which the save keeps at 0x03002188.
